steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: "But the hero's journey continues! The End!"

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Robot anime marathon, done! Yay, another fifteen worlds have been saved!
The girl looks at the automatically ejected disc and stretches her back lazily. The blue standby screen on the huge monitor is reflected on her glasses, casting a deep, dark shade.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: So it's true. As long as I wish for it, I can get a happy ending from the anime.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Then...
The girl pushes her glasses, staring at the flickering noise on the screen.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: What if I want to know the truth about this island?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: What is the actual material composition of this island? Why did it end up forming an island rather than a continent or a city? What does the form of a sunken island represent in the spiritual domain?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I just can't wait... I really want to find out! This island must have some deeper hidden connection with Mania and spiritual power!
She mutters to herself somewhat neurotically while pulling out the huge toolbox that has been there in the corner of the lounge since the start.

The seemingly ordinary metal box opens, reassembles, and expands, eventually forming an array of research instruments several times its original size, along with the dozen or so drones Summer usually has with her.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: A1 to A3, collect samples. A4 to A6, prepare the solutions. A7 to A9, use the loaded weapons to bomb the samples. A10, observe, record, and analyze the different reactions to provide a preliminary hypothesis.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Tasks received. Scanning island. Planning routes...
Under Summer's instructions, the machines operate in an orderly manner.

Despite the chocolate crumbs still on her lips, the eyes behind her glasses are no longer those of the girl marveling at the monitor minutes ago. No doubt, she is now an almost inhumanly meticulous scientist.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Building deconstruction complete. Detected material type: 1.

steps.speaker: Drone
steps.content: Soil and plant sampling complete. Detected material type: 1...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The metal, soil, and plants are all composed of the same substance? No, they are showing metallic properties... What determines the different manifestations of this substance?
Summer rubs it gently, and the sample in her hand suddenly turns into a wisp of blue electronic particles, dispersing in the air.
Oh no, you almost dismantled this island... I've invited a rather dangerous guest.
But it's okay, if taking things apart pleases you so much, do it to your heart's content! Elysiland never neglects its guests' wishes!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: ...One more time, one more time! This should produce the phenotypic differentiation. Hmm, the result is good, but the efficiency is too low. This island's builder couldn't have used such a clumsy method...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: That's right, if that's the case, once I gather enough materials, I could even deconstruct and rebuild this island...

Soon, she's completely dismantled this lounge she had carefully modified, even the beach and library she once adored have become unrecognizable. The plants have turned to ash and the pages are scattered everywhere.
But in her research mode, Summer couldn't care less. Calmly, she continues her experiments with these now-deformed "samples", approaching the "truth".

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Suspected power source... up above me? Hmm? Is that... the island owner's big fish those people were talking about?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: No way. The band and composition feel almost identical to the power I felt when trying to hack into the dark web before... Is the island owner, my friend L, related to the dark web somehow?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I thought you were doing something fun and exciting. Turns out you're just fiddling with this metal stuff?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Should I bring you some more manga? Or should we continue shooting the next tokusatsu film? There's a new chocolate dessert at the restaurant. Let's go try it together!
L.L., who's been Summer's playmate here, emerges behind her stealthily, sounding caring as she speaks.
But Summer doesn't even lift her head now, ignoring her completely.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Why are you ignoring me? The rule of Elysiland is to have fun. If you can't find joy here...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: You will be expelled from Elysiland...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: You measure everything with joy, but I don't.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: In my world, coolness is above everything. If something's both cool and can save the world, that's even better.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Everything else doesn't matter.
Summer pushes her glasses, her eyes behind the lenses incredibly bright.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I want to study that big fish, and you. Did you construct this island and that fish with your power? Why is it able to represent and use the collective consciousness of the dark web to some extent?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: And you. You appeared before me just as I was about to uncover the truth. That's how I know I'm onto something, but you won't let me go any further.
Summer stands up, walks straight through L.L.'s body, and reaches the edge of the island.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I can sense that everything here is virtual data. That includes myself, and you. And the virtuality is meant to cover up the truth.
She turns her head determinedly, leaving the girl and the ruins under her feet behind.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: You don't need to expel me. I mean, how boring would that be? That's not cool at all. I still treasure the time we've spent together.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: So, I've decided to leave on my own. The sight of my leaving must look so cool in the waves under the sun. Just like an iconic scene in an anime!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: But we will definitely meet up again, little fish. Next time, I hope we can chat about anime again. Remember to catch up on the episodes!
The pink-haired girl disappears at the edge of the island. The residual data fragments turn into white powder before they touch anything.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: How interesting... You've barely left behind any data.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Then let's hope we can indeed meet again in the future!
